hooks.command: date_path=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d'); plugin_root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"/../.. && pwd)}"; if [ -f /proc/version ] && grep -qi microsoft /proc/version 2>/dev/null; then export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT_WSL="$plugin_root"; fi; os_type=$(uname -s 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"); if [ "$os_type" = "Linux" ] || [ "$os_type" = "Darwin" ] || [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT_WSL" ]; then script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"; . "$script_dir/inject-grammar-ledger-context.sh"; else powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$plugin_root/scripts/inject-grammar-ledger-context.ps1"; fi
